mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cakeId, c.flavor AS cakeFlavor, #{cakeSize} AS cakeSize, COALESCE(r.reservation_quantity, 0) AS reservationQuantity, COALESCE(( SELECT s.quantity FROM cake_stocks s WHERE s.cake_id = c.id AND s.cake_size = #{cakeSize} ), 0) AS stockQuantity FROM cakes c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cake_id, COUNT(*) AS reservation_quantity FROM reservations WHERE res_date = #{today} AND cake_size = #{cakeSize} AND make_status = 'RESERVED' GROUP BY cake_id ) r ON r.cake_id = c.id ORDER BY c.id ASC
